note: Phase 26 design log (docs/extreme90_phase26.md). Budget fixed before drafting: 8-10 concept proposals, <= 8 substantive revisions per concept after its first draft, <= 16 generator runs, <= 24 full evaluations. Every draft benched with tools/ta90_bench24.gd (d_*.json).

concepts.name: the drill turns around (switch + armor): a flip target rams a shell, must stay, is reversed and rams the shell behind it
concepts.decision: REJECTED before generation: conceptual duplicate of N41 / N38 (one rammer, two shells, one reversal - 'crack the shell in front, stay, be turned round to crack the one behind')

concepts.name: relocated magnet (magnet + armor): magnet M1 pulls magnet M2 into its own cell, moving M2's pull line; fired in place M2 pulls the wrong block
concepts.bench: C1a 1 distinct (6 moves); J1b 1 distinct; J1c unsolvable
concepts.decision: core C1a frozen -> generator (J1_MAGPULLMAG, plain arrows)

concepts.name: reversal into the gate (switch + gate): one reversal and two links of one gate - the link facing the gate needs the flip, the link facing away must be gone first or it is turned to face its own gate (deadlock)
drafts: J2b (+ key turned to face its prisoner)
concepts.bench: G2a 1 distinct; J2b 1 distinct (the same early firing at four steps); J2c unsolvable
concepts.decision: core G2a frozen -> generator (J2_SELFDEADLOCK); J2b's lock half is the same shape, not a separate concept

concepts.name: relocated boomerang (magnet + Sequence + armor): a magnet pulls a first-stage Sequence block into the row of two shells; it rams one, advances (arrow reversed) and rams the other
concepts.bench: G3a 1 distinct; J3b 2 distinct; J3c unsolvable

concepts.name: two-hop relay (magnet + armor): M1 pulls the cargo into M2's line, M2 pulls it again into the only lane that cracks the shell; M2 fired first pulls M1 itself
the gate is the magnet's blindfold (magnet + gate + armor): fire before the gate opens
concepts.bench: 0 distinct: bypass - the rammer finishes its work before the gate opens
concepts.decision: STOPPED: closing the bypass turns it into N52's 'wrong block first' structure (and N22 'unlock, open, pull')

concepts.name: the flip sends the rammer through the portal (switch + portal + armor)
concepts.decision: EXCLUDED: the Phase 23 K2 / Phase 25 H6 concept, already stopped in Phase 25

concepts.name: the magnet is the last key (magnet + lock + armor): one departure pulls the locked rammer and unlocks it
concepts.decision: STOPPED: the lock only prevents an early escape - decoration under the essentiality rule

concepts.name: dormant cargo (magnet + lock): pulled before its key leaves, the locked cargo blocks the key's lane
concepts.decision: STOPPED: geometric contradiction - the delivery cell is the magnet's own cell, which blocks the key's lane until the pull

concepts.name: switch relay (switch is itself the flip target of another switch)
concepts.bench: refused by the parser: 'cannot be a switch and a flip target'

concepts.name: relocated switch (magnet pulls a switch piece into a new lane)
